importarPorUrl.info: Paste an AO3 fic's URL and it gets added to your library. Works with locked fics too, since it uses your logged-in session. The import runs on GitHub Actions (not on this server), so it takes anywhere from one to a few minutes — it won't show up instantly.
importarPorUrl.enCamino: Import underway — it may take a few minutes to show up.

ficDetalle.estadoDeLecturaInfo: Every reading marked "Read" — including rereads — adds the fic's words to "Words read" and "Fics read" on the Dashboard. Changing the status above updates your most recent reading. For a reread to count separately (without overwriting the previous one), use "Log a reread" below: it adds a new reading without deleting the old one.

ao3.info: Fetching new bookmarks runs on GitHub Actions (not on this server), because it can take a while and this host has no direct access to AO3. Below is the history of runs done from your PC's terminal, if you ever use that route.
ao3.sinCorridas: You haven't run any import from the terminal yet.
ao3.actualizarBookmarksInfo: Fetches the new bookmarks you added on AO3 since last time. Runs on GitHub Actions, so your PC doesn't need to be on — it can take several minutes (or more, if AO3 is rate-limiting).
ao3.actualizarBookmarksRapidoInfo: Like "Update bookmarks", but stops as soon as it finds a long streak of already-known bookmarks in a row, instead of always walking every page. Much faster when you only added a few new bookmarks. The tradeoff: if you edited the tag or note on an old bookmark, this mode might miss it — run the full one every so often for that.
ao3.actualizarMarcadosInfo: Fetches the fics you marked as "Marked for Later" on your AO3 History (not a bookmark). For ones you already have, it just adds the "Marked for Later" tag so you can find them in Collections, without touching whatever reading status they already have.
ao3.actualizarSuscripcionesInfo: Fetches the fics you're subscribed to on AO3 (different from bookmarks: you can subscribe to one without bookmarking it). For ones you already have, it adds the "Suscripciones AO3" tag; new ones get fully imported — so "Check WIPs" starts checking them too.
ao3.actualizarWipsInfo: Asks AO3 again about the fics you have marked as incomplete, to detect if they got a new chapter or finished — that shows up in Updates. Only checks ones that weren't checked in the last few days, so running it back to back won't waste requests.
ao3.syncEnCamino: Sync underway — check back on your library in a bit.
